summary: Iteration 105: Complete testing of 3 tasks - (1) Foto fix with /api/uploads/inside/ prefix + ImageCropModal + PDF export, (2) Privacy Policy page with 19 sections and legal references, (3) Strava policy references. All backend tests (9/9) and frontend tests passed.

Backend: export-pdf endpoint returns valid PDF with application/pdf content-type
Backend: graficos_data includes all 7 sections with scores
Frontend (DashboardInstagram.jsx): Form has 4 sections with 15+ fields including ImageCropModal integration
Frontend: Export buttons (XLSX, PDF, CSV) all visible and functional

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 105 validated: (1) Foto URL fix - backend returns /api/uploads/inside/ prefix, frontend displays photos correctly, (2) PDF export working with reportlab, (3) Privacy Policy page at /politica-de-privacidade accessible without login, has 19 sections, includes Strava API/Privacy links, LGPD, Marco Civil references, (4) Footer link on main page navigates to privacy policy. Backend endpoints tested: POST /api/admin/instagram/upload-foto, GET /api/admin/instagram/export-pdf/{id}, GET /api/admin/instagram/export/{id}, GET /api/admin/instagram/analises/{id}. Frontend verified: Form modal with 4 sections and 15+ fields, ImageCropModal for photo cropping, Export buttons (XLSX, PDF, CSV), Foto display in analysis results, Privacy Policy page with 19 expandable sections.
